subject: GREEN: mm.c (brk/mmap/munmap/mprotect) + expand syscall.c iteratively
description: Implement runtime/linux/mm.c (brk arena bounded by app-image-end..vlinux-base per roadmap memory map; mmap MAP_ANONYMOUS bump allocator; munmap/mprotect no-ops with bookkeeping). Extend syscall.c's dispatch table to cover the roadmap's Set 1 list, discovering the ACTUAL required set empirically by iterating: build+run the glibc fixture, read the ENOSYS<nr> diagnostic, implement, repeat -- rather than blindly implementing the full predicted list upfront.
activeForm: Implementing mm.c and expanding the syscall table
